payload_json.summary: Healing Hands triggers on melee hits via Cleric's Hammer node (up to 100% proc chance). Each melee attack auto-fires Healing Hands providing healing and stacked holy/fire damage. Vengeance generates Mana. In solo play, self-sustain is primary use; in party, heals allies.
